newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian troops kill seven leftist rebels.
newsitem.headline: Colombian troops kill seven leftist rebels.

text.p: Seven leftist rebels were killed in clashes with counterinsurgency troops in southwest Colombia on Tuesday and Wednesday, an army spokeswoman said.

She said fighting between the troops and the Jaime Bateman guerrilla force, a renegade faction of the M-19 group, broke out near the town of Caloto in Cauca province. In addition to the seven insurgents killed, two were wounded and captured and a number of assault rifles were seized.
The Jaime Bateman force, named after a leader of the M-19 who died in a plane crash, is the smallest of Colombia's guerrilla armies. It is not thought to number more than 100 rebels.
